title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Billed Rate Used in a Late-Notice Credit
content:
**Tier pricing note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** In the late-notice credit on a room-and-board charge, the late-notice billed rate is the current private pay schedule's daily rate for the tier the charge was posted for, read this way:

| The charge | Late-notice billed rate |
|---|---|
| Posted for a tier that is not the agreement's current tier | The current schedule's daily rate for the charge's tier |
| Posted for the agreement's current tier with the isolation charge basis | The current schedule's daily rate for the agreement's isolation billing tier |
| Any other charge | The current schedule's daily rate for the agreement's own tier |

| Accommodation tier | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 514.00 |

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Reading the tables.** For a charge posted for a tier other than the agreement's current tier, find the charge's tier in the first table. For a charge for the agreement's own tier with the isolation charge basis, find the agreement's tier in the second table, then that isolation billing tier's rate in the first. A tier that is its own isolation billing tier gives the same rate either way.
